purpose: Source discovery for ATU/PBTS and wastewater lift-station evidence in five Northeast Florida counties

sources.coverage: Baker Clay Duval Nassau St. Johns
sources.notes: ATU and PBTS require operating permits; county health departments retain local permitting in these five counties.
DEP lists advanced-system permitted maintenance entities by product and by county/company; not proof of a particular installed unit.
County-sorted wastewater facility worksheets updated nightly; facility record is not itself proof of a lift station.
Official county GIS portal includes utility address request referencing lift stations; no verified bulk lift-station layer yet.
Construction permits, construction approvals and final approvals are different events; none is a verified ATU inventory by itself.

classification_policy.atu_pbts: Require an operating permit, official system type or explicit model tied to a specific record.
classification_policy.lift_station: Require an explicitly identified sanitary wastewater lift station in an authorized utility/permit record; exclude stormwater and ordinary dosing tanks.
classification_policy.unknown: Never infer equipment from KnownSeptic, LikelySeptic, or SWLSeptic classes.
classification_policy.publication: No equipment counts until a verified local dataset and usage rights are established.
